meta_description: Tree Services Liverpool. Professional arborist providing tree surgery, pruning, removal and stump grinding across Merseyside. Same-day quotes available.
hero_eyebrow: Certified Arborist — Fully Insured Tree Surgery
hero_subhead: Dangerous branches hanging over your roof? We fell, prune and remove trees safely, often the same week you call.
services_heading: Complete Tree Surgery Services Across Liverpool
services_subhead: From routine pruning and hedge work to emergency felling and stump removal, we handle every aspect of tree care with precision and safety.

services.title: Tree Felling & Removal
services.desc: Safe removal of hazardous, diseased or unwanted trees, including site clearance and waste chipping. We work in confined spaces and sensitive locations.

services.title: Crown Reduction & Pruning
services.desc: Improve light and reduce weight safely. Crown thinning, lifting and shaping to enhance tree health and protect your property from storm damage.

services.title: Emergency Tree Work
services.desc: Storm damage, fallen branches or trees threatening your home? We attend emergency call-outs quickly to secure the area and prevent further harm.

services.title: Stump Grinding & Removal
services.desc: Grind stumps flush to ground level or remove completely, leaving your garden clear and ready to use. Ideal after tree felling.

services.title: Hedge Trimming & Maintenance
services.desc: Regular hedge cutting to keep boundaries neat and healthy. We maintain domestic and commercial hedgerows to any height or shape.

services.title: Tree Health Assessment
services.desc: Professional survey to identify disease, structural weakness or pest infestation. We advise on treatment, pruning or removal to protect your landscape.

about_pullquote: I started this business because I was tired of seeing trees butchered by cowboys.
about_para_1: Tree Services was founded 18 years ago to bring proper arboricultural standards to Liverpool and Merseyside. We've felled over 2,000 trees safely, from mature oaks to problem pines threatening homes. Every job is planned with safety and the health of your landscape in mind — we're not just here to cut; we're here to do it right.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on turning up when we say we will, doing what we quote, and leaving your garden cleaner than we found it. Homeowners and property managers call us back because we listen to what you actually want — not just what we think you need. We carry full public liability insurance and work to the highest British Standards.
reviews_heading: What Liverpool Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a massive oak looming over the garage after last winter's storm. Called up expecting weeks of waiting, but they came out for a free assessment two days later. Felled it safely, ground the stump, and cleaned up completely. Brilliant work, sensible price, and the bloke knew exactly what he was doing. Would definitely use again.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Our boundary hedge was a complete mess and starting to die off. These lads came, gave me honest advice about what could be saved, trimmed it back hard, and it's already looking twice as good. No hard sell, no fuss. Fair pricing and they cleaned up after themselves. Very impressed.
reviews.author: Linda M.

reviews.text: Emergency call-out when a branch came down in the storm and blocked the drive. They made it safe and tidy in a couple of hours, even though it was a Saturday. Reasonable emergency fee, proper insurance, and friendly throughout. This is how tree surgeons should operate.
reviews.author: David S.
